course_name_en: TEACHING PRACTICE IN COMPULSORY PRE-UNIVERSITY EDUCATION GRADUATING EXAM
prerequisites: Passing the Didactics of the Specialization course
Learning outcomes specific to the Didactics of the Specialization course

learning_outcomes.text: Identifying the main categories of educational activities supported by mentors.
Developing skills, abilities, and attitudes specific to the class teacher.
Observing and evaluating students' academic and social behavior.
Designing, organizing, guiding, and evaluating extracurricular educational activities.
Responsible execution of professional tasks, under conditions of restricted autonomy and qualified assistance.
Familiarization with roles and activities specific to group and team work.

assessment_methods.method: In-semester practice tests (school curriculum, calendar plan, learning unit project)

assessment_rules: The final grade requires a minimum of 7. The final grade is based on 50% for in-semester practice tests, where students create a school curriculum, a calendar plan, and a learning unit project, and 50% for the final evaluation, which involves submitting a pedagogical practice portfolio.
institution: Gheorghe Asachi Technical University of Iași
degree: Inginerie Mecanică (licență, 4 ani / 240 ECTS) - Facultatea de Mecanică
